searches.query: Pelagic squid ecology and closest represented analogue
searches.material_read: Local jumbo-squid paper methods/synthesis; FAO Dosidicus account pp301–304/PDF33–36 gives large size, epipelagic nekton and trophic role. Doryteuthis gahi FAO full catalogue indexed account p88 concerns Patagonian shelf; full download web parser too large.
searches.decision: Very low group6 partial active-nekton analogue; compare fish species pools and euphausiid/benthic compartments. Distinguish shelf squid from large oceanic jumbo squid.

searches.query: Seriolella violacea taxonomy/habitat and Seriolella source spelling

searches.decision: Violacea group6 Medium ecological extension; Seriolella genus includes6/7 at assumed biomass shares; source cearulea spelling crosswalks to caerulea.
